Case Study

Prescripto - Modern Healthcare Management System

An enterprise-grade platform designed to streamline doctor-patient interactions, manage medical records, and facilitate secure telemedicine consultations.

Visit Live Site
{/* Featured Image */}
{/* Project Overview */}

Role

Lead Full-Stack Developer

Technologies

{['MongoDB', 'Express.js', 'React', 'Node.js', 'WebRTC', 'Tailwind CSS'].map(tech => ( {tech} ))}

Year

2024

The Challenge

The healthcare industry often struggles with fragmented systems where patient data, scheduling, and communication happen across different platforms. Prescripto was conceived to solve this by providing a unified, secure, and intuitive environment for both medical professionals and patients.

Key Features

  • 01
    Advanced Scheduling

    Real-time booking system with automated conflict resolution and reminders.

  • 02
    Secure EMR

    Encrypted patient records accessible only to authorized medical personnel.

  • 03
    Telemedicine

    Integrated high-definition video consultations via WebRTC for remote care.

{/* Visual Showcase */}
{/* Outcome */}

The Result

Prescripto successfully reduced patient wait times by 40% and improved data accuracy by 60% across pilot clinics. The platform now supports over 50 doctors and 10,000+ patients monthly.
